==Biography==
José Pombo Ribeiro was born in Caracas, Venezuela.

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Irelia}}.
* He likes [[CuVee]] as a player.
* After fulfilling his duties as General Manager, he became a pro player for [[INFINITY]] in ''Teamfight Tactics'' since 2023.
* With his win at the TFT Remix Rumble LATAM Regional Finals, he became the first player to win a major regional championship in two different Riot Games' titles.
* At the same time, he became the first person to qualify for a World Championship of two Riot esports scenes, in both ''League of Legends'' and ''Teamfight Tactics''.
